I've written the test for this: https://github.com/quantum13/yii2/commit/6923ae31ee5735ac6ad73707be1acb9432132628

I've also found out the reason, why it does not work:
AssetManager::publishDirectory calls FileHelper::copyDirectory
FileHelper::copyDirectory calls filterPath in which option 'only' used only for files (because of e11ce60023b1da918eac8359fe674beca5c7127e)

@samdark could you please say, is it expected behaviour of option 'only' of filterPath and it shouldn't be corrected to affect to both files and dirs?
The commit looks intentional. I'm not sure why though... @yiisoft/core-developers ?

It was an answer to

> @samdark could you please say, is it expected behaviour of option 'only' of filterPath and it shouldn't be corrected to affect to both files and dirs?

body:
Hello. I need help:)
There is big mismatch in docs of functions, what they realy and docs of functions which they use.
I do not know what to fix.

Chain of calls which use this $publishOptions with option 'only':
AssetBundle::publish() -> AssetManager::publish() -> AssetManager::publishDirectory() -> BaseFileHelper::copyDirectory() -> BaseFileHelper::filterPath()

AssetBundle::publish():
In guide (http://www.yiiframework.com/doc-2.0/guide-structure-assets.html#asset-options) is written that syntax 'fonts/' can be used to copy only dir fonts (i.e. whole dire fonts with subdirs and files).
It doesn't work

BaseFileHelper::copyDirectory():
In phpdoc: A path matches a pattern if it contains the pattern string at its end. For example, '.php' matches all file paths ending with '.php'.
It also doesn't work

BaseFileHelper::filterPath():
In phpdoc (lreference to BaseFileHelper::findFiles): Directory paths are not checked against them. Same pattern matching rules as in the "except" option are used (http://www.yiiframework.com/doc-2.0/yii-helpers-basefilehelper.html#findFiles()-detail)

---

Must AssetBundle::publish() and BaseFileHelper::copyDirectory() work as written in guide and doc? Or maybe docs must be rewritten?
The weird behaviour of option 'only' was already reported in [#7307](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/issues/7307#issuecomment-140725307).

`
        'except' => [
            'fonts/',
            'css/'
        ]
`
works fine w/o asterisks

but `'only'` only with asterisks + empty folders - as mentioned above
